note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.1. All three previous defects are fixed: (1) parseSelectionDeferralConfig now uses configjson.ForEachPeer + configjson.PeerRemoteIP, skipping dynamic group templates and DynamicPeerIP, and TestRFC4724RIBSelectionDeferralPerFamilyAndTimer exercises real Ze BGP config JSON (named standalone peers, grouped peer, dynamic group template, string leaves); (2) knownFamilies ensures route-less converged families (proven via IPv4Multicast) are marked released while other families remain deferred; (3) both TestRFC4724RIBSelectionDeferralPerFamilyAndTimer and TestRFC4724SelectionDeferralTimerAndExclusions use 2 non-excluded GR peers plus 1 R=1 peer and 1 non-GR peer, proving partial EoR (1 of 2), duplicate EoR, and unnegotiated-family EoR keep deferral active while 2 of 2 releases per-family without waiting for R=1 or non-GR peers, and remaining deferred families release at Selection_Deferral_Timer expiry.
